# Awesome 3D Prompts

A source-transparent catalog of prompts that produced visible 3D results. The first collection covers **GPT-6 Astra** across Blender, browser 3D, WebGL, Three.js, games, spatial product work, and related workflows.

[Browse the visual 3D Prompt Gallery on BeatAPI](https://beatapi.io/3d-prompts?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=awesome-3d-prompts)

**Review status:** 29 accepted cases toward a target of 50. The remaining gap is intentional: no prompt is invented to fill it.

Every entry separates the model claim, engine, exact or derived instruction, visible result, original source, author, verification date, and rights status. “GPT-6 Astra” identifies the model used in the cited workflow; it does not mean BeatAPI itself is a 3D renderer.
